# MessagePane checks its own splitter class for collapsed-state visibility

For the MessagePane extraction, the review objected to retaining parent references for visibility. The author instead used the element’s own collapsed-by-splitter class, and the landing/fixed implementation uses #isCollapsed in display guards. This avoids keeping a second parent-derived visibility state in this element. It is a local ownership choice, not a ban on every parent access or a general custom-element rule. Static code and full primary review read; no live pane or race test.

Scope: MessagePane state ownership.
